    How it worksThree steps

    Simple by design, from search to checkout.

    The collection is one directory. Find the place, read what is inside, and pay once.

    1. Find the place, then the need

      Search, open the atlas, or pick a kind of help: guides, books, immigration, food, checklists.

    2. Buy, or add to cart

      Buy a title straight away, or keep a few in your cart while you compare what each one covers.

    3. Pay once with Stripe

      Card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay in one secure Stripe checkout. Then download and start reading.

    Marufi Digital is an independent publisher of digital guides and books. Payments are processed by Stripe.

    QuestionsBefore you buy

    Good to know before checkout.

    Short answers about how buying works. Anything else, ask by email from the footer.

    How do I receive my purchase?

    Pay through Stripe's secure checkout. As soon as payment clears you are brought to a confirmation page with your download links, and Stripe emails your receipt. Lost a link later? Use "Resend my download" in the footer.

    What kinds of titles do you publish?

    Travel guides for a place, longer books, immigration and settling-in help, curated restaurant and food lists, and checklists or templates. Every title is filed by country and state and delivered as a digital download. Some help is free and lives in the Free help section.

    How is this different from a free blog?

    A blog post is written to rank. A guide is written to be used: one place, in order, with the timings, prices, and mistakes to avoid, and nothing padded to hit a word count. You read it once and go.

    What does the cart do?

    The cart keeps the titles you choose on this device so you can compare them, then pays for all of them in one Stripe checkout. You can also send an order as a gift.

    Which payment methods can I use?

    Major credit and debit cards, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them. Stripe handles the payment from start to finish.

    Do I need an account?

    No. Browse, search, and fill your cart freely. Stripe only asks for your email and payment details at checkout.

    What if a guide is not what I expected?
